original_card.first_experiment: State one missing boundary lemma in full before starting a proof-assistant build.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

actual_scope: Close the pinned TWOSIDE (5,3) beta residue using a new complete P112 rank-six/eight-deletion bound and mixed-rank transfer.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit C5 handoff in Discussion3156 rather than duplicate the formal-interface card arithmetic. A complete p8 rank-six bound supplies the previously missing eight-line small-piece cover.
bottleneck_link: Narrows the P112 decoder copy-floor proof, a central restriction on changed complex decoder costs. It does not improve a supplier or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after a complete bounded p8 rank-six census and the one-cell implication; do not expand to all beta cells, rank-seven p4, or other C1-C7 obligations.
evidence: All 159 first-flat orbits and all 776,805 second masks pass a code-disjoint dual-code census. The p8 maximum is three; the p4 control maximum is one. All four stated (5,3) shapes are excluded under the pinned transfer hypotheses.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Substantial automated assistance in derivation, implementation, writing and internal read-only review; no independent human or proof-kernel review.
